name: Two-stage training procedure for Relightable 3D Gaussians
definition: A two-stage optimization process to reconstruct relightable scenes from multi-view images, combining standard 3DGS rendering with physically based rendering (PBR) and BRDF decomposition.
summary: This two-stage protocol reconstructs relightable scenes from multi-view images by optimizing geometry with normal gradient densification before refining PBR materials, distinguishing itself from vanilla 3DGS through these specific loss terms.
